blockingFindings: The audited MDrive treatment variable is a complete cooperating-agent LiDAR array rather than the proposed region-time message.
The current code has no verified message serialization, byte accounting, send timestamp, receive timestamp, or propensity hook at the proposed intervention point.
A fixed Bernoulli treatment probability guarantees overlap and therefore does not test the adaptive-policy overlap failures claimed in the dossier.
The dossier did not define the target policies whose values would be estimated.
Coverage cannot be validated from one held-out randomized set without repeated independent logs or a high-precision Monte Carlo reference.
Twenty scenario families with four seeds are not justified for rare collision outcomes, and no minimum detectable effect, confidence-width target, or maximum expansion rule was supplied.
The proposed direct competitors are not executable through one common treatment interface.
The stated 10-12 week schedule on one GPU is not credible for the proposed CARLA matrix.
results.retainedKernel: A randomized intervention with exact logged propensities may be reconsidered only after the treatment is bound to a real code-level variable and a power-justified validation protocol is demonstrated.

blockingFindings: MDrive already directly studies the open-loop versus closed-loop gap with the same four perception-swap model families.
BridgeSim 2026 independently studies the same open-loop versus closed-loop benchmark gap, leaving insufficient novelty for another transfer audit.
The proposed true-replay level is not established by the documented command alone and depends on two environment switches whose replay path is untested.
The replay path can change the detector or checkpoint path, so the claimed frozen comparison is not currently guaranteed.
The cooperative forward path can silently fall back to single-vehicle inference after an IndexError.
The dossier did not audit checkpoint training-data overlap with V2XPnP.
The CARLA execution matrix is substantially larger than the stated resource and schedule assumptions.
results.retainedKernel: None. A generic replay-to-closed-loop verdict audit is treated as a crowded problem family for this direction unless a materially different causal object and substrate are discovered.

roundDecision.nextAction: Search for an independent real-network blind spot with downloadable evidence, executable code hooks, and a smaller falsifiable study.
